ablation.aggregate_policy: equal-scene geometric mean of per-scene paired p95 ratios; scene range is descriptive, not a confidence interval
ablation.isolated_factor: hierarchy next-level selection after certified skip or consumed leaf; same R32 layout and bound
ablation.not_isolated_by_hiz_comparison: RGBA Hi-Z differs in storage and traversal; its speed difference cannot all be assigned to storage

scope_notes: GPU p95 and paired latency ratios use warm trajectory frames; logical-byte counts cover all trajectory frames, including each first frame.
DDA and LightTrace headline p95 values are from their paired campaign; Hi-Z p95 is from the separate Hi-Z campaign.
Reported improvements use paired per-repeat p95 ratios, never division of unpaired aggregate percentiles.
Logical byte reads include recorded depth/traversal records, not physical DRAM traffic or all shader accesses.
RGBA Hi-Z does not count level-table loads: its payload bytes are a lower bound and its total logical traversal bytes are unavailable.
Cold first-trajectory-frame latency and one-time hierarchy construction are reported separately; construction observations exclude device/pipeline creation.
Receiver masks exclude unsupported depth and the image border; rays can cross the common filled/extended field.
Six low-resolution Middlebury fields and two native-resolution ARKitScenes reference-depth frames are eight fixed inputs, not a full-dataset benchmark.
